title: Add an excited option to greet
objective: greet(name, { excited: true }) ends the greeting with an exclamation mark
requirements: greet accepts an optional second argument { excited?: boolean }
when excited is true the result is the usual greeting followed by a single '!'
without the option, or with excited false, the result is unchanged
constraints: keep greet a named export of src/greet.mjs

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given greet('Ada', { excited: true }), when called, then it returns 'Hello, Ada!'
Given greet('Ada'), when called, then it still returns 'Hello, Ada'

plan: Add the options parameter to src/greet.mjs
